changelog:
Initial release of the free-ride skill.

- Adds core functionality for managing free OpenRouter AI models in OpenClaw.
- Automatically ranks free models by quality and configures fallbacks for rate-limit resilience.
- Writes only to relevant config keys, preserving existing user configuration.
- Adds a watcher daemon for automatic recovery when all model fallbacks are rate-limited.
- Documentation and usage instructions updated via SKILL.md; removed redundant skill-card.md.
